description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint that receives the workspace's events: every event, or the listed types. Returns the endpoint with its `signing_secret`, which is shown only this once.

description.description: A note of your own to tell endpoints apart, up to 255 characters. Left out, `description` is null.

event_types.description: Events to deliver, at least one. "*" is every event except thread.created, thread.updated, thread.deleted and message.delayed, sent only to an endpoint that names them.

url.description: The `https://` URL events are POSTed to. Its host must resolve to public IP addresses only. A host that does not resolve, or resolves to a private, loopback or link-local address, is refused with 400 `invalid_param_value`.

name: mails_webhooks_create
title: Create a webhook endpoint
